component.name: LPods
component.summary: Battery, noise control and ear detection for your AirPods

description.p: LPods is a Linux port of WPods. It talks to your AirPods over Bluetooth with Apple's accessory protocol and shows their battery, switches between noise cancellation, transparency and adaptive, and pauses your media when you take an AirPod out.
LPods is an independent project. It isn't made, sponsored, endorsed or supported by Apple.
